summary: authors Gouget & Girard. `gipt` must be a multiple of 10; recommend ≥ 20. `kf` and `tp` may alternatively be given per element in `<ElementData>` with tag `MRVonMisesParameters`. `mat_axis` may be in Material or ElementData section. First `mat_axis` vector `a` is the reference direction for `tp`.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.2.18 Mooney-Rivlin Von Mises Distributed Fibers (Sclera and other thin soft tissues), p195（4.13）

tp.meaning: Preferred fiber orientation (angle within fiber plane, w.r.t. first direction in `mat_axis`)

vmc.meaning: Choice of von Mises distribution (1 = semi-circular von Mises; 2 = constrained von Mises mixture)

mat_axis.meaning: Reference frame of the plane of the fibers

example.source: pyfebio 默认值不足以构造出该材料，需人工补全必要参数后给出示例。
